item.title: An interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson on the "risk" of a romantic story, switching from GTA V's split storyline to co-dependent partnership, and more (Andrew Webster/The Verge)
item.description:
Andrew Webster / The Verge:
An interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson on the “risk” of a romantic story, switching from GTA V's split storyline to co-dependent partnership, and more  —  Grand Theft Auto VI isn't just the biggest GTA game to date; it's also the most romantic.

item.title: GTA VI's main campaign completion time ranged from 42 hours for a "rushed" playthrough to 115 hours for an exploration-heavy playthrough across four reviewers (IGN)
item.description:
IGN:
GTA VI's main campaign completion time ranged from 42 hours for a “rushed” playthrough to 115 hours for an exploration-heavy playthrough across four reviewers  —  How many hours does it take to play Grand Theft Auto 6?  We have completion times from four different people.  —  Learn More

item.title: London-based Payhawk, which offers enterprise expense and procurement management tools, raised a $280M Series C led by Goldman Sachs at a $2B valuation (Yazhou Sun/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Yazhou Sun / Bloomberg:
London-based Payhawk, which offers enterprise expense and procurement management tools, raised a $280M Series C led by Goldman Sachs at a $2B valuation  —  Payhawk, a fintech startup that helps businesses manage expenses, has raised fresh financing led by the growth equity arm …
